One spoken verse in the learner's space (z, ż, P)

Gen 1:8 in Hebrew (Talking Bibles International, one narrator, 76.65–83.55 s of Genesis): 839 waves (voice cycles) = steps of SKA real-time learning, fresh learner. Input: all 16 harmonics, u = Σ Re ċ_h, scale 1. Horizontal axes: z = ‖Z‖ and ż = dz/dt (1/s); vertical axis: P = exp(−|ΔH/H|). Colours: the 17 voiced stretches (split at gaps > 20 ms), dark = early, light = late.

Replay: ▶ plays the verse with its sound, one wave at a time at the narrator's pace (1× = real time). Desktop: drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, right-drag to pan. Headset: press Enter VR; trigger = highlight next stretch, grip = show all.
